description: Portable structural limits for scripts/prettify-benchmark.mjs: render/memory counters of the seeded ?e2e initial scene (every local villager selected) at the original baseline commit. No frame timing and no GPU-specific performance claim; timing needs a same-machine --baseline FILE. Triangle limits include +12 per scene (+24 with the desktop-high shadow pass): SwiftShader (--software) draws one more box than the original Metal capture, measured identically at 36a80cd itself (2026-11-11). L15 terrain chunking (2026-11-20, SwiftShader): calls and triangles use the new measured selected-scene maxima; geometry ceilings are one above the measured counts because chunks share vertices but own indices. Texture and quality ceilings are unchanged.
